products.title: Born Free Folding Camp Stretcher
products.body_html:
A good night’s sleep makes the next day’s drive a lot easier. The Born Free Folding Stretcher gets you off the cold, uneven ground and onto a roomy 205 x 80cm bed that sets up in minutes, whether you’re under canvas in the Drakensberg or pitched beside the bakkie at a Kalahari campsite.

The oversize design gives you space to stretch out and turn over, and the frame supports up to 120kg. The bed is made from hard-wearing 600D Oxford fabric, stretched over a square-tube frame on folding X-legs for a stable base on grass, sand or gravel. A built-in utility pouch keeps your torch, phone and book within reach at night.

When it’s time to move on, the stretcher folds down and slides into its carry bag, made from the same tough fabric as the bed, so it packs neatly into the canopy or drawer system without snagging your other gear.

Features

  • Oversize 205 x 80cm sleeping surface with room to stretch out
  • 120kg weight rating
  • Durable, lightweight folding frame
  • Hard-wearing 600D Oxford fabric bed
  • Utility pouch for keeping essentials close at night
  • Matching 600D carry bag for easy packing and storage

Specifications
Brand Born Free
Bed size 205 x 80cm
Weight rating 120kg
Frame tube 25 x 25 x 0.9mm square tube
Bed fabric 600D Oxford
Carry bag 600D Oxford (same as bed)
Included Utility pouch, carry bag

products.title: Born Free Satara 250E Envelope Sleeping Bag
products.body_html:
The Born Free Satara 250E is made for the kind of camping most of us do between spring and autumn: warm days, cool nights and a long drive to get there. Whether you’re parked up in the Lowveld or camping out in the Karoo, it gives you a comfortable night’s sleep without taking up half the load bay.

The envelope shape gives your legs and feet room to move, so you’re not wrapped up like a mummy. Inside, a soft terry cotton lining feels more like your own bed than a nylon shell, while the hollow fibre polyester filling traps warmth on cooler nights. The outer is made from 240T diamond honeycomb ripstop polyester, which helps stop small snags from turning into big tears.

An insulated zip baffle runs alongside the zip to block the cold spot that zips are known for. At 1.3kg, it’s light enough to carry from the vehicle to the tent without a second thought.

The Satara 250E has a comfort rating of +10°C and an extreme rating of -5°C. The comfort rating is the one to plan around. The extreme rating is a survival limit, not a comfortable night, so for winter trips or high-altitude camps, pair it with a liner or consider a warmer bag.

Features

  • Envelope shape for more room to move
  • Comfort rating: +10°C
  • Extreme rating: -5°C
  • Insulated zip baffle to reduce cold spots along the zip
  • Soft terry cotton inner lining
  • Tear-resistant ripstop outer

Specifications
Brand Born Free
Model Satara 250E
Type Envelope
Size 190cm (L) x 85cm (W)
Weight 1.3kg
Comfort rating +10°C
Extreme rating -5°C
Outer 240T diamond honeycomb ripstop polyester
Inner Terry cotton
Filling Hollow fibre polyester

products.title: Born Free Sabi 250C Hooded Sleeping Bag
products.body_html:
Product description

Cool nights in camp often catch you at the head and shoulders first. The Born Free Sabi 250C adds a built-in cowl hood to a roomy rectangular bag, so you can pull it in around your head when the temperature drops after sunset, whether you’re camped along the Sabie River or up in the Magaliesberg.

The body keeps the generous rectangular shape, so there’s room to move your legs and turn over without feeling boxed in. Inside, a soft terry cotton lining feels closer to home bedding than a slippery shell, and the hollow fibre polyester filling holds warmth on cooler nights. The outer is 240T diamond honeycomb ripstop polyester, which helps stop small snags from spreading into bigger tears.

An insulated zip baffle runs alongside the zip to cut down the draught that zips tend to let in. At 1.7kg, it packs easily into the vehicle with the rest of your camp kit.

The Sabi 250C has a comfort rating of +10°C and an extreme rating of -5°C. Plan your trip around the comfort rating. The extreme rating is a survival limit rather than a comfortable night, so for winter or high-altitude camping, add a liner or look at a warmer bag.

Features

  • Cowl hood for extra warmth around the head and shoulders
  • Roomy rectangular body
  • Comfort rating: +10°C
  • Extreme rating: -5°C
  • Insulated zip baffle to reduce cold spots along the zip
  • Soft terry cotton inner lining
  • Tear-resistant ripstop outer

products.title: IM2.5 Suspension Kit - Heavy
products.body_html:
The aluminium advantage

Aluminium is lighter than steel; in fact, the IM2.5 offers a 30% weight reduction over a twin-tube steel shock absorber. Additionally, the use of aircraft-grade 6061-T6 aluminium in the IM2.5 offers improved cooling, which in turn means a shock absorber that can run harder, for longer, without diminishing its performance. Aluminium is known for its improved heat management and has four times the thermal conductivity of steel.

Ultimate tuning

The IM2.5 Monotube suspension series features a CNC ported billet aluminium piston with an O-ring sealed PTFE Teflon band. The precision channelling allows for ultimate tuning to soften the smallest of bumps in the road. The billet aluminium Internal Floating Piston (IFP) features class-leading NOK seals and separates the high-pressure 200 PSI nitrogen gas from the Fuchs hydraulic oil.

Built to last

With a wall thickness ranging from 3–4 mm across the range, the IM2.5 monotube shock absorber tube is finished with ultra-thick and durable Type 2 anodising for ultimate protection. The monotube technology has also allowed us to mount the shock absorbers upside down, keeping the monotube body mounted high and away from rocks and debris. The 20 mm hardened steel piston rod is positioned downward, yet protected by a robust dirt shield.

Complete by design

Most suspension kits stop at the shocks - leaving you to source Upper Control Arms separately. Not the IM2.5. Upper Control Arms are included as standard, ensuring correct suspension geometry and precise handling from the moment of fitment. No compromise. No additional parts to chase down. Just a complete, properly engineered suspension system that's ready to perform from day one.

The Ironman 4x4 Foam Cell Pro 'A' Lift Kit is the ultimate Outback solution. This kit is matched with 'A' (light) springs. products.title: Side Steps & Rails
products.body_html:
Step and protect in one with the Ironman 4x4 Side Step & Rail Kit

Engineered for durability and reliability in any weather condition, our side step and rail kit (aka. scrub bars and steps) help protect your 4WD's front quarter panel and lower body from otherwise nasty damage.

This full-side protection features a modern, slip-resistant, and durable textured powder coat tread plate and offers a heavy-duty aftermarket alternative to the manufacturer's standard side steps or running boards.

Key Features

  • ADR compliant and compatible with all safety features.
  • Step with confidence thanks to the slip-resistant dimple finish of the side steps.
  • Built to last, our side steps and rail kits are constructed from 50mm tubular heavy-duty, corrosion-resistant steel.
  • The vehicle specific design ensures seemless integreation
  • 3-year warranty.

Optional Upgrades

  • Colour-coded tubes

Frequently Asked Questions

Are side steps worth it?

They'll make an amazing complement to your 4WD, making it easier and safer to step in and out as well as access the roof

Are side rails the same thing as scrub bars and brush bars?

Yes, side rails are just another name for scrub bars or brush bars, all of which are names used to describe a protection bar which connects between your bull bar and side steps.

Are these side steps universal?

At Ironman 4x4 we design vehicle specific products for seemless integration, these side steps (running boards) are designed specifically to suit the compatible series. Use the MY BUILD feature to find a full range of product designed for your 4x4.

Can I install side steps myself?

Instructions are available for DIY installation, and we also provide a national network of Ironman 4x4 stores with experienced and qualified fitters to install your side steps for you.

Are these side steps compliant?

Vehicles with side and curtain airbags have legal requirements for side steps to be airbag-compatible. Ironman 4Ã—4 has gone through extensive airbag compatibility designing and testing to meet the requirements of airbag compatibility.
